content.text: {"classification":"troubled","summary":"CRM cutover to cloud is slipping and at risk on data quality, key-person knowledge, and training, with a fixed April shutdown target that conflicts with readiness.","signals":[{"id":"S1","observation":"Cutover date has already slipped twice from 1 March.","evidence":"Cutover was planned for 1 March and has already moved twice."},{"id":"S2","observation":"Trial data load has a high failure rate on customer records.","evidence":"A trial data load found that 12% of customer records fail validation, mostly duplicate contacts and missing country codes."},{"id":"S3","observation":"Only one person knows the old schema and is leaving soon.","evidence":"The only database administrator who knows the old schema has handed in their notice and leaves in five weeks."},{"id":"S4","observation":"Agents are untrained with busy season approaching.","evidence":"The support manager says agents haven't been trained yet and is worried about the busy season starting in May."},{"id":"S5","observation":"Sponsor's April shutdown deadline conflicts with the readiness status.","evidence":"The sponsor still expects the old system to be switched off by the end of April to avoid another licence renewal."}],"things_to_watch":["Whether the DBA's schema knowledge is documented before they leave in five weeks.","Duplicate and country-code fixes needed to bring the 12% failure rate down before the next load.","Whether agent training can finish before May.","Whether the sponsor will accept a later shutdown or a licence extension instead of the April deadline."]}
